enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn body to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up to chin. Turn to right side. Place arm under pillow. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Stretch legs. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wash body with soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry body with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, milk. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Pour eggs. Stir. Turn off cooker. Place eggs on plate. Take toast. Fill kettle. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the computer workstation and reviewing the day's patient schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Open laptop. Place laptop on desk. Connect power cord. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open scheduling software. Enter password. Review patient list. Scroll through appointments. Make notes. Close software.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home as a health care professional, conducting telehealth consultations and updating patient records on the computer (no commute due to the transport strike)
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Put on headset. Open video conferencing app. Join first patient call. Greet patient. Discuss symptoms. Type notes. End call. Open patient record. Update record. Save. Open next patient file. Call next patient. Repeat. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch, reheating food in the microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out leftover container. Close refrigerator. Open microwave door. Place container inside. Close door. Press buttons to set time. Press start. Wait for beep. Open door. Take out container. Close door. Place on counter. Remove lid. Stir food. Get utensils. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Short rest and stretching break away from the screen
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from chair. Walk away from desk. Raise arms overhead. Stretch. Bend forward. Touch toes. Twist torso. Roll shoulders. Walk around room. Sit back down.

enriched_activities.activity: Resuming remote health care work, following up with patients and completing administrative tasks on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email. Read messages. Reply to emails. Open patient files. Make phone calls. Type notes. Update records. Schedule appointments. Print documents. File documents. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue tasks.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Pick up clutter. Put items away. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under table. Turn off vacuum. Unplug. Wind cord. Put vacuum away. Close closet.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Take off work clothes. Fold clothes. Place in hamper. Open dresser drawer. Take out t-shirt and sweatpants. Put on t-shirt. Put on sweatpants. Lie on bed. Close eyes. Rest. Turn to side. Adjust pillow.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Turn off range hood. Place food on plate. Sit down. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand at sink. Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start. Walk away.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Stop on program. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Cross legs. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch more TV. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit down. Continue watching.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and drying off
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time, browsing the phone and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll. Like posts. Comment. Switch to TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch more TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, turning off the lamp and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Open drawer. Take out pajamas. Change into pajamas. Fold clothes. Place on chair. Turn off lamp. Pull back covers. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Turn to side. Pull blanket up. Rest.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Place arm under pillow. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
